summary: Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on October 7, 2026, attaching a press release that announced over $10 million in additional SkyEdge IV orders from a leading satellite operator, with deliveries scheduled over the next 12 months. The filing is a routine current report on an ordinary commercial order rather than a special situation. No transaction terms, stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed. No risk-arb angle; the event is immaterial to capital structure and reflects ongoing product demand.
